# `ollama` — `/api/ollama`

Ollama router — the models on an Ollama server: list, show, pull (streamed progress), unload from VRAM and delete, plus a ping and starting a local `ollama serve`.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| DELETE | [`/api/ollama/model`](#delete-api-ollama-model) | Delete a model from an Ollama server. |
| GET | [`/api/ollama/models`](#get-api-ollama-models) | List all models available on an Ollama server. |
| GET | [`/api/ollama/ping`](#get-api-ollama-ping) | Check whether an Ollama server is online. |
| POST | [`/api/ollama/pull`](#post-api-ollama-pull) | Stream a model pull from an Ollama server, returning NDJSON progress lines. |
| GET | [`/api/ollama/running`](#get-api-ollama-running) | Return models currently loaded in memory via Ollama /api/ps. |
| GET | [`/api/ollama/show`](#get-api-ollama-show) | Return model metadata from Ollama /api/show. |
| POST | [`/api/ollama/start-local`](#post-api-ollama-start-local) | Start ollama serve on localhost if it isn't already running. |
| POST | [`/api/ollama/unload`](#post-api-ollama-unload) | Evict a model from VRAM immediately, freeing memory for other GPU tools. |

<a id="post-api-ollama-unload"></a>
### `POST /api/ollama/unload`

Evict a model from VRAM immediately, freeing memory for other GPU tools.

keep_alive: 0 on a generate call is Ollama's documented mechanism for this — it unloads without running real inference (no prompt is sent).

- Handler: [`unload_model`](../../../backend/routers/ollama.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `UnloadRequest`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | string | yes |  |  |
| `server_host` | string | no | `"localhost"` |  |
| `server_port` | integer | no | `11434` |  |

**Response**
